==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xuxu:''' One, two, three... These Green Rabbits should be enough to last a week.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Xuxu:''' As you can see, I'm processing the ingredients. First, wash them, then peel them, and finally chop them into small pieces. Add scallions, ginger, and garlic, and stir-fry them...
:{{DIcon}} Why eat the cute rabbits?
::'''Xuxu:''' Because rabbit meat is delicious! Freshly cooked rabbit meat has a soft texture and delicious taste... Just thinking about it makes my mouth water!
:{{DIcon}} It sounds delicious.
::'''Xuxu:''' Freshly cooked rabbit meat has a soft texture and delicious taste... Just thinking about it makes my mouth water!
:'''Xuxu:''' Desorock Highland is far from Jinzhou. Even fresh meat will become dry and tough after being transported here.
:'''Xuxu:''' It's better to have some fresh meat here and satisfy our cravings.
{{Dialogue End}}
